`loudness.set_enabled` (protocol 1.47, ADR-0092): starts or stops the main canvas's
loudness meter. Session state: a restart of the app starts with it off.
input_schema.title: SetLoudnessEnabled

output_schema.description:
`loudness.status` (protocol 1.47, ADR-0092 stage 1): the loudness of the main
canvas's mix after ITU-R BS.1770-4 and EBU R 128. Each value is `null` while it has
no data: the meter is off, its window has not filled since it started or was
reset, or the programme so far is below the -70 LUFS gate.

integrated.description: Integrated loudness since the meter started or was reset, LUFS.

momentary_max.description: Highest momentary loudness over the same time, LUFS.

range.description: Loudness range (EBU Tech 3342) over the same time, LU.

short_term_max.description: Highest short-term loudness over the same time, LUFS.

true_peak_max.description: Highest true peak over the same time, dBTP.

output_schema.title: LoudnessStatus
